scheme: Bounded degree-three Bernstein joint curves over real key depression, optimized jointly over each complete micro-sequence. Exact inherited digit anchors at unpressed contact; per-digit quintic approach/recovery and inherited quintic key return. No independent per-frame IK, no branch switches, no post-hoc smoothing.

joint_bounds_deg.meaning: Flexion1/2/3 then base spread. Increment from already curved RSSF rest; not global anatomical joint angles.

root_policy.shared_root: Exact Human-approved root matrix throughout each sequence; constant root is continuous and avoids transporting hand per note.

original_absolute_bounds.interpretation: Common root can differ from R1. Left maximum root height reduced70→68mm; right65mm cap. Root bounds decided before solve.

temporal_limits.meaning: A priori engineering constraints for original 35ms key descent; not physiological limits.

stages.APPROACH: 120ms quintic preparation-to-approved contact, ends at unchanged NOTE_ON
stages.CONTACT: Exact approved active digit anchor at NOTE_ON with static key surface; preceding finger may still be releasing
stages.KEY_PRESS: Inherited 35ms key descent, active digit follows transformed registered contact point
stages.HOLD: Full down-key surface tracking until unchanged NOTE_OFF
stages.RELEASE: Inherited70ms key rebound tracked to unpressed contact
stages.RECOVERY: Quintic lift to inherited preparation digit; end=min(off+220ms,next same-digit on-120ms). Minimum60ms in these events, computed before generation.

anchor_overlap: Left NOTE_OFF coincides with next NOTE_ON. Preserve source full static scenes and per-digit anchors; a releasing digit and arriving digit can coexist, so dynamic whole-hand NOTE_ON is not falsely equated to a static full-hand endpoint.
idle_reference: Left index/middle/ring use exact approved L1 values; right other four use exact approved R1 values. No new home-key IK.

contact.registered_contact_gap: Preserve original approved gap approximately0.5mm relative to rotated key top

clearance.scope: All3300 evaluated vertices against all88 actual key pieces, in inverse-current-key frame at120Hz. Not full triangle collision certification; inspect normal views.

optimization.method: One deterministic bounded scipy least_squares per hand over all Bernstein coefficients, forming one candidate with two sequences
optimization.one_seed: Contact anchor repeated three times, clipped strictly inside already locked control bounds
optimization.skin_collocation: Predeclared approach and recovery quarter points, press fractions0,.25,.5,.75,1 and release quarters
optimization.left_bound_relief: Contact anchors unchanged at original limits. All pressure control points for L1 little MCP/spread <=upper-.5deg and L2 thumb IP<=upper-.5deg; near-bound dwell independently measured. No range expansion.

failure_rule: Keep sole finite bounded candidate, report PARTIAL or FAIL_CLOSED on contact, temporal, bounds, visible or anchor conflicts. No parameter sweep, retuning or second candidate. Fix genuine implementation errors only.
audio: No engine development. Use inherited legal samples and original velocity/event times for isolated excerpt if available.
